===FINDING 1===
LEAD: In this 20-Gram-Panchayat sample, recorded expenditure on costed activities was Rs 51.96 crore below planned cost, with the gap spread across all 16 blocks and nearly every asset category. Rangeilunda and Kalimela merit first review: they recorded gaps of Rs 9.11 crore and Rs 5.90 crore respectively, spending only about 23% of planned cost.
DETAIL: The finding covers 5,630 costed activities planned from 2020-21 to 2025-26. In 27 of 28 asset-category groupings, the shortfall was broadly distributed across blocks rather than concentrated in one place; Banking Facilities was the only category without a clear distribution pattern. Officials should reconcile plans, expenditure and work status—especially in Rangeilunda and Kalimela—and check whether the gaps reflect ongoing or delayed works, outdated plans, or missing payment records. The data shows only the difference between planned cost and recorded expenditure; it does not establish the cause or whether works were physically completed.
